where: whole park: ICESat-2 laser altimeter ground tracks
value_text: getTracks for bbox 116.275-116.325 E, 39.990-40.022 N: total 2, track [232, 255]
source_title: NASA ICESat-2 via OpenAltimetry API (getTracks)
note: The only open height data finer than GLO-30 that I found: two reference ground tracks (RGT 232, 255) cross the bbox, each with 3 beam pairs and repeats every 91 days. ATL08 gives terrain height in 100 m segments, ATL03 photons every 0.7 m along track (footprint about 11-17 m): a true profile across any hill a beam crosses, ground under trees often resolved. Follow-up (5 calls): RGT 255 passed on 2019-04-14; its ATL08 terrain points (every ~100 m) lie at lon 116.2777-116.2826 (beams gt2l/gt2r, along the outside of the Yuan Ming Yuan west wall, about 200 m W of 紫碧山房 H0052) and 116.3154-116.3204 (gt3l/gt3r, just east of 长春园 and 绮春园): both pairs miss the gardens' hills. Their ground reads 36.3-39.2 m WGS84 ellipsoid (about 45-47 m EGM2008 with an assumed geoid of about -9 m, unknown offset), a dip to 30.7-33.8 m at 40.012-40.013 N on the west line. RGT 232 gave no ATL08 points on 2019-04-13 and 2019-07-13. So ICESat-2 gives no hill height here; GEDI (also open, sparse 25 m shots) not checked. Raw answers in scratch r10_hills_osm/.

A long rockery wall faces the pavilion; new two-storey 松雲樓 built "on the height" 因高新築兩層樓, so the rockery or a mound carried a building. Also 露香齋 verse: 假山有真樹 ... 玲瓏石竅間 (rockery with real trees and holed stones). The 1836 fire on this axis may have changed it (S41).

where: all round the compound, north of the river crossed from 五福堂
value_text: 由五福堂渡河而北山阜旋繞内為碧桐書院
source_title: 欽定日下舊聞考 Rixia jiuwen kao (S05), Yu Minzhong 于敏中 et al., 1780s; Kanripo KR2k0036, WYG 四庫全書 base
note: Ring: "hills and mounds wind round; inside is 碧桐書院". TX-135 cites the passage for the path; here for the ring of hills enclosing the court.

where: west of the main hall of 碧桐書院
value_text: 其西巖石上為雲岑亭
source_title: 欽定日下舊聞考 Rixia jiuwen kao (S05), Yu Minzhong 于敏中 et al., 1780s; Kanripo KR2k0036, WYG 四庫全書 base
note: A pavilion 雲岑亭 on rock to the west: a rockery (or rock-faced mound) high enough to carry a pavilion.

where: beside the main hall 杏花春館
value_text: 館旁峰石上刋御製杏花春館詩
source_title: 欽定日下舊聞考 Rixia jiuwen kao (S05), Yu Minzhong 于敏中 et al., 1780s; Kanripo KR2k0036, WYG 四庫全書 base
note: A standing peak stone 峰石 beside the hall, with the 1744 poem carved on it. Single stone.

where: south of 杏花村: a ravine; entrance by a hill pavilion
value_text: 村南為磵壑餘清 / 由山亭邐迤而入
source_title: 欽定日下舊聞考 Rixia jiuwen kao (S05), Yu Minzhong 于敏中 et al., 1780s; Kanripo KR2k0036, WYG 四庫全書 base
note: A ravine 磵壑 (building name 磵壑餘清) south of the village; the 1744 preface enters "winding in from the hill pavilion" 山亭. Hills at the entrance; side not stated.

where: in the court of 長春仙館
value_text: 庭徑有梧有石堪供小憩
source_title: 欽定日下舊聞考 Rixia jiuwen kao (S05), Yu Minzhong 于敏中 et al., 1780s; Kanripo KR2k0036, WYG 四庫全書 base
note: "In the court paths there are wutong trees and stones to rest on": stones in the court. Qianlong's 1744 preface to the Forty Scenes poem (御製圓明園四十景詩, S40) as quoted in S05.

where: north face of the 卍 hall (room 高山流水)
value_text: 疏泉還叠石位置儼天然
state_date: 1764 (萬方安和 eight-room verses, cf. TX-057)
source_title: 欽定日下舊聞考 Rixia jiuwen kao (S05), Yu Minzhong 于敏中 et al., 1780s; Kanripo KR2k0036, WYG 四庫全書 base
note: "A spring led out and rocks piled, placed as if by nature": a piled-stone rockery with a spring by the north room 高山流水. The east room 山水清音: 山峙水常流 (a hill stands, water flows). The 卍 hall stands in water, so the rockery is on the bank or a small islet (our inference).

where: north of the main court, reached from 萬方安和 over a bridge east then a little north
value_text: 萬方安和後度橋折而東稍北石洞之南為武陵春色 / 武陵春色石洞内額曰壺中天
source_title: 欽定日下舊聞考 Rixia jiuwen kao (S05), Yu Minzhong 于敏中 et al., 1780s; Kanripo KR2k0036, WYG 四庫全書 base
note: A walk-in rock cave 石洞 with a plaque inside (壺中天): kind cave 洞. 武陵春色 lies south of the cave.

where: along the stream running north through the scene; behind the hall a pass to 桃花塢
value_text: 循溪流而北複谷環抱山桃萬株參錯林麓間 / 複岫迴環一水通 / 堂後由山口入
source_title: 欽定日下舊聞考 Rixia jiuwen kao (S05), Yu Minzhong 于敏中 et al., 1780s; Kanripo KR2k0036, WYG 四庫全書 base
note: Double valleys: "following the stream north, layered valleys embrace it, ten thousand mountain peach trees among the wooded foot of the hills"; "layered peaks wind round, one water passes through". Hills on both sides of a stream, with a pass 山口 behind the hall.

where: behind (east of) the west-facing nine-bay hall; river in front; flat field in the middle
value_text: 樓西向九楹後擁連岡前帶河流中央地勢平衍凡數頃
source_title: 欽定日下舊聞考 Rixia jiuwen kao (S05), Yu Minzhong 于敏中 et al., 1780s; Kanripo KR2k0036, WYG 四庫全書 base
note: A chain of ridges 連岡 backs the hall on the east (the hall faces west); in the middle the ground is flat over several 頃 (1 頃 = 100 畝, about 6.1 ha; "several" not counted). The 1744 preface (j81:18a): 在園之西南隅地勢平衍.

where: north of 山高水長: a bridge then a pass 山口 into 月地雲居
value_text: 山髙水長之北度橋由山口入
source_title: 欽定日下舊聞考 Rixia jiuwen kao (S05), Yu Minzhong 于敏中 et al., 1780s; Kanripo KR2k0036, WYG 四庫全書 base
note: A hill crossed by a pass between YM15 and YM16.

where: behind (north of) the temple; a hill path leads on to 鴻慈永祜
value_text: 琳宫一區背山臨流 / 月地雲居之後循山徑入為鴻慈永祜
source_title: 欽定日下舊聞考 Rixia jiuwen kao (S05), Yu Minzhong 于敏中 et al., 1780s; Kanripo KR2k0036, WYG 四庫全書 base
note: "A temple backed by a hill, facing the stream". The hill lies north, between YM16 and YM17 (TX-063 cites j81:19b for the path).

where: outside the east wall of 安佑宫, between it and 匯芳書院
value_text: 鴻慈永祜東垣外徑連岡三重度橋而東則彚芳書院也
source_title: 欽定日下舊聞考 Rixia jiuwen kao (S05), Yu Minzhong 于敏中 et al., 1780s; Kanripo KR2k0036, WYG 四庫全書 base
note: Three ranges of ridges 連岡三重 east of the east wall; the path crosses them, then a bridge to YM18. TX-064 cites it for the path; here for the count of ridges (three parallel ridges).

where: the site itself
value_text: 苑西北地最爽塏
source_title: 欽定日下舊聞考 Rixia jiuwen kao (S05), Yu Minzhong 于敏中 et al., 1780s; Kanripo KR2k0036, WYG 四庫全書 base
note: "The north-west of the garden is the highest and driest ground" (爽塏 = high and dry). The NW corner stands higher than the rest; no figure. Qianlong's 1744 preface to the Forty Scenes poem (御製圓明園四十景詩, S40) as quoted in S05.

where: east side of 紫碧山房, in a rock cave
value_text: 山房東巖洞中為石帆室
source_title: 欽定日下舊聞考 Rixia jiuwen kao (S05), Yu Minzhong 于敏中 et al., 1780s; Kanripo KR2k0036, WYG 四庫全書 base
note: A room 石帆室 inside a rock cave 巖洞 on the east of 紫碧山房: kind cave. 紫碧山房 lies NW of 鴻慈永祜 behind its rear wall. No height for the hill of 紫碧山房 in S05.

where: east side, beside the crescent-shaped study
value_text: 東偏學月牙形搆小齋數椽旁列虚亭竒石負土爭出穴洞谽谺翠蔓䝉絡可攀捫而上
source_title: 欽定日下舊聞考 Rixia jiuwen kao (S05), Yu Minzhong 于敏中 et al., 1780s; Kanripo KR2k0036, WYG 四庫全書 base
note: An earth-and-rock hill: "strange rocks bearing earth thrust out, caves gape, green creepers cover it, one can climb it by hand". Kinds: earth hill faced with rock, caves, climbable; a pavilion beside it. Qianlong's 1744 preface to the Forty Scenes poem (御製圓明園四十景詩, S40) as quoted in S05.

where: outside 多稼軒: a rockery with a bamboo pavilion on top
value_text: 出多稼軒假山嶙峋嶻嶭尺寸千里盤石磴而上縳竹為亭名曰寸碧
state_date: 1759 (乾隆二十四年 多稼軒十景詩)
source_title: 欽定日下舊聞考 Rixia jiuwen kao (S05), Yu Minzhong 于敏中 et al., 1780s; Kanripo KR2k0036, WYG 四庫全書 base
note: "Leaving 多稼軒, the rockery is craggy and steep, a thousand li in a foot; winding stone steps go up to a pavilion of tied bamboo, 寸碧亭". Rockery with stepped way 磴道 and summit pavilion. The 十景 preface: 磴引三盤之趣 (steps in three turns), 嶺畔樓髙 (a tall building by the ridge).

where: due north of the 多稼軒 pond (正北為互妙樓)
value_text: 山之妙在擁樓而樓之妙在納山 / 層構單椒上前峯復列屏
source_title: 欽定日下舊聞考 Rixia jiuwen kao (S05), Yu Minzhong 于敏中 et al., 1780s; Kanripo KR2k0036, WYG 四庫全書 base
note: "The hill embraces the building and the building takes in the hill"; "a storeyed building on a single peak top, peaks in front like a screen". A hill north of the pond carrying 互妙樓. Also 招鶴磴 (a stone stair) west of the pond, j81:29a, j81:32b.

where: 映水蘭香: north part, by 印月池 (釣魚磯北為印月池)
value_text: rock_faced (釣魚磯)
source_title: 欽定日下舊聞考 Rixia jiuwen kao (S05), Yu Minzhong 于敏中 et al., 1780s; Kanripo KR2k0036, WYG 四庫全書 base
note: A fishing rock 磯 at the water: one rock ledge, not a whole shore. Kind rock_faced for that spot only.

where: within the scene, side not stated
value_text: 坡有桃沼有蓮
source_title: 欽定日下舊聞考 Rixia jiuwen kao (S05), Yu Minzhong 于敏中 et al., 1780s; Kanripo KR2k0036, WYG 四庫全書 base
note: "The slopes have peach trees, the ponds lotus": slopes 坡, low. Qianlong's 1744 preface to the Forty Scenes poem (御製圓明園四十景詩, S40) as quoted in S05.

where: south of the main hall: a pass 山口 to 多子亭
value_text: 南出山口為多子亭
source_title: 欽定日下舊聞考 Rixia jiuwen kao (S05), Yu Minzhong 于敏中 et al., 1780s; Kanripo KR2k0036, WYG 四庫全書 base
note: A hill crossed by a pass on the south side. Plaque 溪山 north of 鋪翠環流.

where: west of the river in front of 西峯秀色 (the hall faces west over it); a 龍王廟 behind it
value_text: 北逺山村西南有室臨河西向為西峯秀色河西松巒峻峙為小匡廬後有龍王廟
source_title: 欽定日下舊聞考 Rixia jiuwen kao (S05), Yu Minzhong 于敏中 et al., 1780s; Kanripo KR2k0036, WYG 四庫全書 base
note: A steep pine-clad hill 松巒峻峙 named 小匡廬 "Little Mount Lu" west of the river. The 1744 preface (j82:7a): 面臨翠巘 (faces a green peak) and 嵦地高軒 (a tall hall on high ground). Height not stated.

where: west of the river
value_text: 松巒峻峙
source_title: 欽定日下舊聞考 Rixia jiuwen kao (S05), Yu Minzhong 于敏中 et al., 1780s; Kanripo KR2k0036, WYG 四庫全書 base
note: Steep 峻峙: a steep-sided wooded hill, not a low mound.

where: just inside the gate of 安瀾園 (四宜書屋)
value_text: 入園門樸室三間背倚峯屏右臨池鏡
state_date: 1764 (乾隆二十九年 安瀾園十詠)
source_title: 欽定日下舊聞考 Rixia jiuwen kao (S05), Yu Minzhong 于敏中 et al., 1780s; Kanripo KR2k0036, WYG 四庫全書 base
note: A peak screen 峯屏 behind the three-bay room: rockery wall at its back, pond on its right.

where: west, a little south of 烟月清真樓 (j82:8b)
value_text: 房築假山上而逺納西山秀色
source_title: 欽定日下舊聞考 Rixia jiuwen kao (S05), Yu Minzhong 于敏中 et al., 1780s; Kanripo KR2k0036, WYG 四庫全書 base
note: The building stands on a rockery and looks far to the Western Hills: a rockery large enough to carry a hall.

where: 安瀾園, position in the compound not stated
value_text: 一峯秀拔亭據其上每當縱望園外稻塍千頃皆在目中
source_title: 欽定日下舊聞考 Rixia jiuwen kao (S05), Yu Minzhong 于敏中 et al., 1780s; Kanripo KR2k0036, WYG 四庫全書 base
note: "A single peak rises fine, the pavilion sits on top; looking out, a thousand 頃 of rice fields outside the garden are in view." The hill must be higher than the garden wall to see over it (our inference, no figure).

where: unstated
value_text: 高岡翽羽鳴
source_title: 欽定日下舊聞考 Rixia jiuwen kao (S05), Yu Minzhong 于敏中 et al., 1780s; Kanripo KR2k0036, WYG 四庫全書 base
note: "On the high ridge the phoenix calls": a quotation of the Shijing (鳳凰鳴矣于彼高岡). Literary; weak evidence for a hill. Qianlong's 1744 preface to the Forty Scenes poem (御製圓明園四十景詩, S40) as quoted in S05.

where: west shore of 福海 (福海西壖)
value_text: earth_slope (竹嶼蘆汀)
source_title: 欽定日下舊聞考 Rixia jiuwen kao (S05), Yu Minzhong 于敏中 et al., 1780s; Kanripo KR2k0036, WYG 四庫全書 base
note: "Bamboo islets and reed shoals": a soft reedy shore, not stone (our reading of 蘆汀 as earth slope). Qianlong's 1744 preface to the Forty Scenes poem (御製圓明園四十景詩, S40) as quoted in S05.

where: behind the hall (it faces the lake 福海, NW corner); a pass 山口 to the NE
value_text: 倚山面湖 / 東北出山口臨河為花嶼蘭皋
source_title: 欽定日下舊聞考 Rixia jiuwen kao (S05), Yu Minzhong 于敏中 et al., 1780s; Kanripo KR2k0036, WYG 四庫全書 base
note: "Leaning on the hill, facing the lake": hill behind (north-west, away from 福海). A pass NE leads to the river at 花嶼蘭皋; 兩峯挿雲 is a building name.

where: the three islands in 福海
value_text: 福海中作大小三島仿李思訓畫意為仙山樓閣之狀
source_title: 欽定日下舊聞考 Rixia jiuwen kao (S05), Yu Minzhong 于敏中 et al., 1780s; Kanripo KR2k0036, WYG 四庫全書 base
note: "In 福海 three islands large and small were made, after Li Sixun's paintings, in the form of immortal mountains with towers." Islands shaped as hills; no height. Qianlong's 1744 preface to the Forty Scenes poem (御製圓明園四十景詩, S40) as quoted in S05.

where: round the hall, east corner of 福海
value_text: 平岡縈迴碧沚停蓄
source_title: 欽定日下舊聞考 Rixia jiuwen kao (S05), Yu Minzhong 于敏中 et al., 1780s; Kanripo KR2k0036, WYG 四庫全書 base
note: "Low ridges wind round, green islets hold still water": low ridges 平岡 (flat-topped, low). 隔岸數峯 = peaks across the water (view). Qianlong's 1744 preface to the Forty Scenes poem (御製圓明園四十景詩, S40) as quoted in S05.

where: behind (north of) the five-bay hall; river on the south
value_text: 接秀山房之南有敞宇北依山南臨河為别有洞天五楹
source_title: 欽定日下舊聞考 Rixia jiuwen kao (S05), Yu Minzhong 于敏中 et al., 1780s; Kanripo KR2k0036, WYG 四庫全書 base
note: Hill north, river south. The 1744 preface (j82:19a) says there is no need of steep peaks: 正不必傾岑峻磵, so the hills here are low (our reading).

where: beside the bridge-pavilion over the water
value_text: 畫欄倒影旁厓懸瀑水衝激石罅琤琮自鳴
source_title: 欽定日下舊聞考 Rixia jiuwen kao (S05), Yu Minzhong 于敏中 et al., 1780s; Kanripo KR2k0036, WYG 四庫全書 base
note: "Beside it a cliff with a hanging waterfall, water dashing through rock clefts rings by itself": a rock cliff with a cascade. Height not given. Qianlong's 1744 preface to the Forty Scenes poem (御製圓明園四十景詩, S40) as quoted in S05.

where: round the compound; pond dug behind (north)
value_text: 平岡迴合山禽渚鳥逺近相呼後鑿曲池
source_title: 欽定日下舊聞考 Rixia jiuwen kao (S05), Yu Minzhong 于敏中 et al., 1780s; Kanripo KR2k0036, WYG 四庫全書 base
note: "Low ridges close round"; a winding pond dug behind the hall. Qianlong's 1744 preface to the Forty Scenes poem (御製圓明園四十景詩, S40) as quoted in S05.

where: north of 採芝徑, a rock cave on the way west to 峭蒨居
value_text: 又北徑巖洞而西為峭蒨居 / 竒石㟏岈迴互徑出其中
source_title: 欽定日下舊聞考 Rixia jiuwen kao (S05), Yu Minzhong 于敏中 et al., 1780s; Kanripo KR2k0036, WYG 四庫全書 base
note: A passage through a rock cave 巖洞, and at 峭蒨居 "strange rocks, gaping, turn round each other, the path comes out among them": a walk-through rockery.

where: west of 披雲徑, on a summit; 韻石淙 a little south-west
value_text: 山巔笠亭孤標秀出左顧飛瀑右挹雲林 / 詭石蒼松
source_title: 欽定日下舊聞考 Rixia jiuwen kao (S05), Yu Minzhong 于敏中 et al., 1780s; Kanripo KR2k0036, WYG 四庫全書 base
note: A hat pavilion on a hilltop with a waterfall on its left; strange rocks and pines. Rockery or rock-faced hill high enough for a fall.

where: west, a little south, of 啟秀亭
value_text: rock_faced (迸水摐摐下石磯)
source_title: 欽定日下舊聞考 Rixia jiuwen kao (S05), Yu Minzhong 于敏中 et al., 1780s; Kanripo KR2k0036, WYG 四庫全書 base
note: "Water bursts and splashes down stone ledges" in a winding ravine 曲澗: a rock-faced stream bed.

where: outside the wall, facing east
value_text: 因迥為高結搆清層樓
source_title: 欽定日下舊聞考 Rixia jiuwen kao (S05), Yu Minzhong 于敏中 et al., 1780s; Kanripo KR2k0036, WYG 四庫全書 base
note: "Using the distance as height, a clear storeyed building was raised": a two-storey building; ground height not stated.

where: in a narrow ravine
value_text: 仄澗中潨泉奔滙竒石峭列為坻為碕為嶼為奥
source_title: 欽定日下舊聞考 Rixia jiuwen kao (S05), Yu Minzhong 于敏中 et al., 1780s; Kanripo KR2k0036, WYG 四庫全書 base
note: "In a narrow ravine springs rush together; strange rocks stand steeply in rows, forming shoals, bends, islets and coves": a rockery ravine. Qianlong's 1744 preface to the Forty Scenes poem (御製圓明園四十景詩, S40) as quoted in S05.

where: the ravine stream
value_text: rock_faced (竒石峭列為坻為碕)
source_title: 欽定日下舊聞考 Rixia jiuwen kao (S05), Yu Minzhong 于敏中 et al., 1780s; Kanripo KR2k0036, WYG 四庫全書 base
note: The stream banks are steep rocks 竒石峭列. Qianlong's 1744 preface to the Forty Scenes poem (御製圓明園四十景詩, S40) as quoted in S05.

where: along the stream going east
value_text: 縁溪而東徑曲折如蟻盤 ... 幽巖石厂别有天地
source_title: 欽定日下舊聞考 Rixia jiuwen kao (S05), Yu Minzhong 于敏中 et al., 1780s; Kanripo KR2k0036, WYG 四庫全書 base
note: "Dark rocks and stone shelters": rock overhangs 石厂 along the winding path (TX-072 cites the path). Poem: 幽蘭泛重阿 (layered hills, 重阿). Qianlong's 1744 preface to the Forty Scenes poem (御製圓明園四十景詩, S40) as quoted in S05.

where: in front of (south of) the pavilion
value_text: 閣前石為玲峯
source_title: 欽定日下舊聞考 Rixia jiuwen kao (S05), Yu Minzhong 于敏中 et al., 1780s; Kanripo KR2k0036, WYG 四庫全書 base
note: 玲峯 a single tall holed stone from 大房山 (Fangshan), poems of 1775 and 1776 (j81:37b-39a), "八十一穴". No height in S05.

where: round the pavilion (after 文津閣 at Chengde)
value_text: 詭石堆竒岫
state_date: 1776 (乾隆四十一年 文源閣詩)
source_title: 欽定日下舊聞考 Rixia jiuwen kao (S05), Yu Minzhong 于敏中 et al., 1780s; Kanripo KR2k0036, WYG 四庫全書 base
note: "Strange stones piled into strange peaks": a piled rockery with a 月臺 terrace.

where: north-west of 雲容水態 (in 澹懷堂), on the way to the 含經堂 gate

value_text: 防渗工程的技术采用复合土工膜材料；防渗方式在技术处理上，能留有0.5到1.5米的覆土，可以栽植水生植物

So today's beds stand some 0.5-1.5 m above the membrane, which itself lies on the dug bed: today's depths are not 1860's. Same article: 杨振铎 says the garden had two supply systems, 万泉河 and 玉泉山, which had almost dried up six or seven years before (c.1998); the park then needed about 9 million m3 a year and got 1.5 million.
